subject: Request to substitute an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping

messages.text: We're proposing an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 and want sign-off before we order material. This is becoming a priority given current supplier lead times. No impact to the plumbing fixture budget is anticipated. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order. Note: the unrelated water-meter billing dispute from last month does not apply to this substitution.

The submittal for an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 is acceptable provided it shows equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings for the assembly it replaces. No impact to the plumbing fixture budget is anticipated.
